post_audit_closures.closure: The main validator now requires exactly the five configured prefixes plus @vocab; the full run and both mutation suites were rerun successfully.

post_audit_closures.issue: The PyLD generator source was outside the eight-file reviewer scope.
post_audit_closures.closure: The generator is retained as src/validate_jsonld_processor.py and is included in the immutable run manifest and freeze inventory; this was an audit-scope limitation, not a failed scientific criterion.

safe_claim: Across 18 frozen comparison cases, the JSON-LD gate engine and an independent clean-room implementation reproduced all claim classes and field-evidence bindings exactly; gate-ablation utility is observed only on this case set.
forbidden_claims: Certified, official, or standards-body-validated Croissant/PROV-O extension
Empirical truth of manually adjudicated metadata
Universal transferability, generalizability, or profile completeness
Model, method, dataset, or pipeline superiority
External validity, public-release readiness, DOI issuance, upload, or submission authorization
General validity of any n=1 class or gate effect
required_manuscript_caveats: The PyLD pre-gate verifies syntax, local-context expansion, and input-hash binding; it is not Croissant certification or metadata-truth adjudication.
Field-evidence binding is an auditable mechanical link, not proof that source content is correct.
own_test_only, lineage_only, not_identifiable, and the pairing-gate ablation effect each have n=1 support.
All exactness claims are restricted to the hash-pinned 18-case input.
